newsitem.title: JAPAN: Awa Bank to issue 40.53 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Awa Bank to issue 40.53 mln new shares.

text.p: Awa Bank Ltd said on Wednesday that it had decided to issue 40.53 million new shares at 300 yen per share in order to increase its capital.
The Tokushima-based regional bank expects to raise 12.16 billion yen through the new issue, the bank said in a statement.
New shares will be allotted to investors who own Awa Bank shares at the end of January 31, 1997. The bank will allot 0.2 new share for every one share.
Applications for the new shares should be made between March 5-17, 1997, and the payment date is set for March 31, 1997, it said.
On Wednesday Awa Bank's shares closed up nine yen at 620 yen.
